integrity: Exact mathematical proof and a standalone reproducibility checker included. Same-model scientific review only; finite enumeration supports but does not prove the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: All-dimensional result for K_{2,n}, n>=2 only. Range projector is onto nonzero Walsh multipliers, not onto tree-incidence frequencies; no endpoint pseudoinverse norm is claimed. Bounded priority search; independent validation not performed.
title: Parity jump in the sharp range-projection norms of \(K_{2,n}\) spanning-tree convolution
